title: Kitabisa Mobile App — Habit-Forming Donation Experience

content.text: I led the end-to-end design of the Kitabisa mobile app from 0 → 1 in 2018, launched in May 2019, and evolved it into a habit-forming giving platform used by millions of users.

Product Vision

Transform donation from a one-time action into a daily habit through a seamless, frictionless, and emotionally engaging experience.

Phase 1 — Mobile Foundation (2019)

  • Designed a fast and simple donation flow with minimal steps
  • Integrated multiple payment methods including GoPay
  • Enabled donations starting from Rp1,000 (for acquisitions users strategy)li>
  • Created dedicated journeys for Zakat, Qurban, Zakat Fitrah, and Zakat Maal

Outcome: Higher mobile conversion and stronger user trust through a modern, lightweight experience.

Phase 2 — Engagement & Habit Formation (2021)

The strategy shifted from enabling transactions to building long-term giving behavior.

  • Donasi Otomatis: recurring donations to remove decision fatigue and increase retention
  • Donation Streak & Kalender Kebaikan: gamified consistency with progress visibility and streak recovery
  • Ecosystem expansion: Sharia Insurance (Saling Jaga) and Voluntrip
  • Header card system: personalized and faster access to key features

Outcome: Increased donation frequency, stronger recurring user retention, and deeper emotional engagement.

Phase 3 — Frictionless & Habit-First Experience (2026)

  • Shifted from campaign marketplace to a personalized giving journey
  • Reduced steps and cognitive load to speed up donation
  • Moved "Kalender Kebaikan" to the top to reinforce daily motivation
  • Simplified UI with feature-driven navigation

Outcome: Faster time to donate, higher repeat behavior, and a more focused, intuitive product experience.

Design Process

  • Behavioral data and funnel analysis
  • User interviews (one-time vs recurring donors)
  • Gamification and layout exploration
  • Iterative delivery with product and engineering

Key Learnings

  • Giving is a behavior, not just a transaction
  • Visibility drives consistency
  • Recurring users sustain the ecosystem
  • UX can strengthen emotional and spiritual motivation

Impact

This product evolution helped transform Kitabisa from a donation platform into a daily kindness ecosystem — turning generosity into a long-term habit.
